clips.title: The story
paras: The Simple Memorandum is an official notice delivered to novice gnome warriors training in Coldridge Valley. A terse gnomish directive, it instructs fledglings to report to the warrior trainer Thran Khorman in Anvilmar to prepare for the war to take back Gnomeregan.

Novice adventurers in Coldridge Valley frequently find themselves entrusted with letters of introduction as they demonstrate their mettle against the local wildlife and trogg threats. For young gnome fighters, this memorandum serves as a formal order to report to Thran Khorman, the resident warrior trainer within Anvilmar. Dwarven veterans recognize that while gnomes may rely on intellect and contraptions, retaking Gnomeregan will demand pure physical resolve and martial discipline. The memorandum directs the bearer to put aside preliminary tasks and seek personalized instruction in the art of war.
